y-m-53-06.goal: Tonga zvinogona kutaurwa pamusoro pezviratidzo zvemidzi kubva pazviratidzo zvema coefficients oga, gadzira zvirevo zve quadratic zvinosangana namamiriro iwe pachako, uye utsanangure chikonzero.

y-m-53-06.s.s1.prompt: Kana b ne c dzose dziri pamusoro, chirevo chipi chakakodzera pamusoro pemidzi yechirevo ichi?
y-m-53-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kana ukaisa nhamba dziri pamusoro se 1, 2, 3 pa x, nyora kana mazwi matatu echirevo (x², bx, c) ega ega ari pamusoro kana negative.

y-m-53-06.s.s1.r.a: Isa nhamba shoma dziri pamusoro pa x uye utarise kana kukosha kwa x²+bx+c kuchiva 0.
y-m-53-06.s.s1.o.b: Kana pane midzi, mumwe uri pamusoro nomumwe negative
y-m-53-06.s.s1.r.b: Funga kuti chakawanikwa chemidzi miviri chaizova nechiratidzo chipi kana umwe uri pamusoro uye umwe negative.
y-m-53-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakaongorora chiratidzo chezwi rega rega rechirevo kana x iri pamusoro. Wakafungidzira zviratidzo zvemidzi kubva pazviratidzo zvema coefficients.
y-m-53-06.s.s1.o.d: Hatigoni kutaura chinhu pamusoro pemidzi kubva pa b ne c oga
y-m-53-06.s.s1.r.d: Kana ukagadzira mapeya maviri kana matatu e b ne c uye ukatsvaga midzi, unogona kuona chimwe chinhu chavo chakafanana.
y-m-53-06.s.s1.explain: Kana x>0, saka x², bx, ne c dzose dziri pamusoro, saka x²+bx+c>0. Saka hapana x iri pamusoro inoita kuti ive 0. Kana pane midzi, yose ndi 0 kana pasi, uye sezvo c>0, 0 haisi mudzi zvakare, saka midzi yose ine negative.
y-m-53-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira zvirevo 3 zvakasiyana x²+bx+c=0 umo b ne c dzose dziri pamusoro uye dzine midzi miviri yakasiyana iri nhamba dzizere, uye uise b ne c. (b inhamba yechisikigo yakazara ye 30 kana shoma, c inhamba yechisikigo yakazara ye 200 kana shoma)

y-m-53-06.s.s2.hint.1: Isa midzi muchirevo chawakagadzira kuti utarise kuti chinova 0, uye utarisewo kuti midzi miviri yakasiyana.

y-m-53-06.s.s2.fail.c1: b inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara iri pamusoro kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 30, uye c nhamba yakazara iri pamusoro kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 200.
y-m-53-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Midzi miviri chaiyo yakasiyana haiitiki. Ingava nyaya apo midzi inopindirana kana pasina.
y-m-53-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Midzi haisi nhamba dzizere. Tsvaga midzi miviri uye uchinje b ne c kuti ive nhamba dzizere.
y-m-53-06.s.s2.explain: Kana ukasarudza midzi kutanga, se −1 ne −6, uye ukaparadzira (x+1)(x+6)=x²+7x+6, saka b=7 ne c=6. Semuenzaniso, (5, 6) ine midzi −2, −3; (7, 12) ine midzi −3, −4; (6, 8) ine midzi −2, −4. b=2, c=1 haishande nokuti ine mudzi mumwe chete wakaenzana −1.

y-m-53-03.topic: Quadratic equations: nhamba yemareal roots necoefficient k
y-m-53-03.goal: Dzidza kuti kune quadratic equation ine tsamba mucoefficient, nhamba yemareal roots inochinja zvichienderana nekukosha kwetsamba, taura ruzivo rwunodiwa (chiyero che k), uye uwane iwe amene kukosha kwemiganhu.
y-m-53-03.material: k imhedziso chaiyo yakagara, uye x inhamba chaiyo. Fungidzira equation x²+kx+4=0. (x² zvinoreva 'x squared.') Wana kuti equation iyi ine mareal roots mangani, ndiko kuti, mhinduro umo x inhamba chaiyo.
y-m-53-03.thinking.1: Kupatsanura kuita nyaya nekutaura mhedziso pamwe chete nemamiriro ayo

y-m-53-03.prereq.3: Kuziva kuti mutaurire wequadratic unogona kunyorwa sei zvakare muchimiro chekuzadzisa square, kana quadratic formula (discriminant).
y-m-53-03.s.s1.prompt: Usingazive kukosha kwe k, unogona kutaura nhamba yemareal roots yeequation iyi senhamba imwe chete here?
y-m-53-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa nhamba mbiri kana matatu dzakasiyana kuna k uye uongorore imwe neimwe kana pane maroots.
y-m-53-03.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mutebhura kana nhamba yemaroots yakafanana kana yakasiyana kana kukosha kwe k kuchichinja.

y-m-53-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakaedza kukosha kwangani kwe k? Kana k=1, ongorora kana pane x inoita x²+x+4 ienzane ne0.
y-m-53-03.s.s1.o.b: Kana k yakanaka pane mareal roots 2, uye kana isina hapana mareal roots
y-m-53-03.s.s1.r.b: Kuona kana inosarudzwa nechiratidzo che k oga, isa k=1, k=5, k=−5 uye uwane maroots.
y-m-53-03.s.s1.o.c: Unofanira kuziva kukosha (chiyero) che k kusarudza nhamba yemareal roots
y-m-53-03.s.s1.r.c: Yakacherekedza kuti ruzivo rwakashaya uye yakatotaura kuti ruzivo rupi rumwe runodiwa. Kana coefficient ichichinja, equation inochinjawo.

y-m-53-03.s.s1.r.d: Isa k=5 kana k=1 uye uverenge nhamba yemaroots zvakananga.
y-m-53-03.s.s1.explain: Kana k=5, saka x²+5x+4=(x+1)(x+4), saka pane mareal roots maviri, −1 ne−4, uye kana k=1, saka x²+x+4 inogara yakanaka, saka hapana mareal roots. Nhamba yemaroots inochinja ne k, saka tinoda kuziva kukosha kana chiyero che k.
y-m-53-03.s.s2.prompt: Isa kukosha 2 kwakasiyana kwe k umo pane real root 1 chete chaiyo (nyaya umo maroots maviri akaenzana anopindirana).
y-m-53-03.s.s2.hint.0: Isa nhamba dzakawanda kuna k uye ugadzire tebhura rekuti x²+kx+4=0 ine mareal roots mangani.
y-m-53-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza k iri padhuze nepo nhamba yemareal roots inochinja kubva pa2 kuenda ku0 uye uiedze zvakananga.

y-m-53-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Kune k iyi hapana real root imwe chete chaiyo. Tarisa kana x²+kx+4 ichitora chimiro che (x+chimwe)².
y-m-53-03.s.s2.explain: Kana k=4, saka x²+4x+4=(x+2)², uye kana k=−4, saka x²−4x+4=(x−2)², saka imwe neimwe ine real root imwe chete. Idzi mbiri ndidzo k dzega dzine root imwe.
y-m-53-03.s.s3.prompt: Nyora, nenyaya, kuti nhamba yemareal roots inochinja sei zvichienderana nekukosha kwe k. Pawo ipa kukosha chaiko sa k=5 ne k=1 semienzaniso.
y-m-53-03.s.s3.hint.0: Isa k=0, k=2, k=3, k=5, k=6 nezvimwewo, uye urongedze mutebhura kana pane maroots.
y-m-53-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga mutebhura kwanenge kuchinja nhamba yemaroots, uye uongorore nekuisa kukosha iko zvakananga.
y-m-53-03.s.s3.hint.2: Nyora zvakare x²+kx+4 uchishandisa chimiro che (x+k/2)² uye utarise kuti chiratidzo chechikamu chasara chinochinja sei ne k.

y-m-53-01.material: Sua akanyora izvi mubhuku rake. “Kunhamba chaiyo a ne b dzipi neapi, (a+b)² ne a²+b² zvakaenzana.” Pano (a+b)² zvinoreva 'square ya a pamwe b,' uye a²+b² zvinoreva 'a squared pamwe b squared.' y-m-53-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pakuedza kwega kwega, verenga kukosha kwe (a+b)² ne a²+b² wega uye uzvinyore padivi nedivi.

y-m-53-01.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana ukaunganidza kukosha kunobuda kwakaenzana, haugoni kutaura 'nguva dzose.' Unofanira kutsvaga kukosha kusingaenderani.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakaedzawo kukosha umo huwandu i0. Usingaisi kukosha, haugoni kuona musiyano pakati pemitaurire miviri.
y-m-53-01.s.s1.explain: Kana a=1, b=2, saka (1+2)²=9 ne 1²+2²=5, dzakasiyana, uye kana a=3, b=−3, saka 0²=0 ne 9+9=18, dzakasiyana. Kune rimwe divi, kuna a=2, b=0 na a=0, b=5, mitaurire miviri yakaenzana. Kukosha kwakaenzana kwakawanda sei kwaunounganidza, hakuvimbisi 'nguva dzose,' uye kukosha kumwe chete kwakasiyana kunoputsa chirevo.
y-m-53-01.s.s2.prompt: Isa (a, b) 3 dzakasiyana dzinoita kuti chirevo chaSua chive chakarurama nemukana, ndiko kuti, kukosha kwemitaurire miviri kwakaenzana. Bvisa nyaya umo a ne b zvose i0, uye chengeta hukuru hwenhamba dzose mbiri pa100 kana pasi. (Kuchinjana a ne b kunoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.)

y-m-53-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Hukuru (absolute values) hwe a ne b hunofanira kuva 100 kana pasi.

y-m-53-01.s.s2.explain: Sezvo (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b², kuti mitaurire miviri ienzane, 2ab=0 inofanira kushanda. Saka dzakaenzana chete kukosha umo imwe ya a kana b i0, sa3 ne0, kana 0 ne−4.

y-m-53-10.goal: Sarudza zvakanyorwa zvinotsanangura zvakakwana chirevo chekuti 'product yema integers maviri akatevedzana i even,' zadza iwe pachako chiitiko chashaikwa, uye unyore zvakare setsananguro inogona kunzwisisika neshamwari.
y-m-53-10.material: n i integer. Chirevo: "Product n(n+1) yema integers maviri akatevedzana inogara iri even." Vadzidzi vana vakatsanangura chirevo ichi. Tsananguro ㄱ: Kune n=1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, ma products 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42, 56, 72 aiva even ese. Ndakatarisa kusvika ku 8, saka inogara iri even. Tsananguro ㄴ: Kana n i even, ngatitii n=2k; saka n(n+1)=2k(2k+1). Inobvisa 2, saka i even. Naizvozvo inogara iri even. Tsananguro ㄷ: n ne n+1 i ma integers maviri akatevedzana, saka even ne odd zvinoshandurana. Saka imwe yemaviri inofanira kuva multiple ye 2, uye product i multiple ye 2 zvakare, ndiko kuti, even. Tsananguro ㄹ: Kana n i even, n=2k uye n(n+1)=2k(2k+1). Kana n i odd, ngatitii n+1=2k; saka n(n+1)=2kn. Muzviitiko zvese i multiple ye 2, saka i even.
